async function run(items) {
 for (const item of items) {
  switch (item.kind) { case 'a':
   // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
   await save(item); break;
  }
 }
 for (const item of items) {
  for (const child of item.children) { if (child.done) break; }
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
  await save(item);
 }
 for (const item of items) { await save(item); if (item.done) break; }
}
